tools.name: OptiScaler
tools.description: Swaps a game's DLSS, FSR or XeSS upscaler for another one and can add frame generation. Open its in-game menu with the Insert key.
tools.notice: WSGM is not affiliated with OptiScaler. Report problems to WSGM.
tools.antiCheatWarning: Do not use with online games. Anti-cheat may ban accounts.

channels.label: Nightly
channels.description: Daily test builds of the next version; may be unstable

options.hint: Often works better for Xbox and Microsoft Store games.

proxy.intro: OptiScaler loads by taking the name of a Windows library the game loads. Try the first one first.
proxy.renameIntro: WSGM renames the installed file. Try another name when the game ignores OptiScaler or crashes.

addons.name: OptiPatcher
addons.description: An OptiScaler plugin that unlocks this game's DLSS and DLSS frame generation inputs without spoofing an NVIDIA graphics card, which saves the spoofing's overhead.

settings.label: DLSS inputs on AMD and Intel
settings.description: Lets the game offer DLSS so OptiScaler can replace it. Turn off if the game misbehaves.

settings.label: Menu scale
settings.description: Size of OptiScaler's in-game menu. About 1.2 suits handheld screens.

settings.label: Hide the startup message
settings.description: Skips the message OptiScaler shows when the game starts.

tools.name: DXVK
tools.description: Translates Direct3D 8, 9, 10 and 11 to Vulkan. Requires a Vulkan-capable GPU and driver; Windows game compatibility varies. Only the selected API and architecture are installed.
tools.notice: Downloaded directly from the official publisher. No binaries are bundled with WSGM.
tools.antiCheatWarning: Graphics injectors can be rejected by anti-cheat or result in an online account ban. Only install when the game permits modifications.
